title: TRICARE Select Bank Draft Amount
content:
A one-time bank draft toward a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment whose elected payment method is an allotment, an electronic funds transfer or a recurring card payment is computed on the enrollment's latest installment.

**Enrollments covered.** It covers a fee-bearing enrollment (one carrying the family's fee billing) that took effect in the plan year that contains the payment date and whose elected payment method is an allotment, an electronic funds transfer or a recurring card payment, so that every installment whose coverage period has begun belongs to that plan year; for any other enrollment this calculation settles nothing.

**Standing of the enrollment.** An enrollment's standing is its lifecycle status: it has ended when its status is disenrolled voluntarily, disenrolled for nonpayment, terminated as ineligible or transferred out, whatever the payment date, and its last day of coverage is then the disenrollment date on its record; it is active when its status is active; and it is awaiting activation when its status is applied. A rejected enrollment owes no fee and is outside these rules.

**Latest installment.** The latest installment is the enrollment's first installment, the charge whose coverage period starts on the effective date.

**Installment period.** An installment covers one calendar month, its installment period.

**Installment owed.** The installment is owed at the tier's family annual fee. Where only one installment's coverage period has begun on the enrollment, so that it is the enrollment's first, and the enrollment took effect after the first month of that installment's calendar period, the installment owed is one twelfth of the annual fee for each month from the month containing the effective date through the end of the period; where the enrollment ended before the last month of the installment period that contains its last day of coverage, it is one twelfth of the annual fee for each month from the start of that period through the month containing the last day of coverage, that month counted whole; otherwise it is one twelfth of the annual fee for each month the installment covers; each figure is rounded to the cent.

**Charges counted.** The enrollment's first installment counts as a charge on the account.

**Bank draft.** The installment owed plus the amount by which the charges counted, other than those of the latest installment, exceed the payments posted on the fee account (nothing where they do not), rounded to the cent and never below zero.

## Conventions

One twelfth of the annual fee is the annual fee divided by 12. Months are calendar months reckoned on the calendar from 2000-01-01, 12 to a plan year, and an installment's coverage period has begun when it starts on or before the payment date, the fee account being read back over 600 months.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, family annual fee 396.00)

| Latest installment | Months owed | Installment owed | Counted charges beside it | Bank draft |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| the first installment, one calendar month | 1 | 396.00 divided by 12: 33.00 | none | 33.00 |

The same enrollment on TRICARE Select Retiree Group B (family annual fee 1190.16) gives 99.18.
